name: Validate URL
description: Is this a web address (http or https)? Answers { valid, value, host } or { valid: false, reason } — a website on a supplier record, a link in a form, a webhook address.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { try { const u = new URL(String(url ?? '').trim()); return u.protocol === 'http:' || u.protocol === 'https:' ? { valid: true, value: u.href, host: u.hostname } : { valid: false, reason: 'Only http and https' }; } catch (e) { return { valid: false, reason: 'Not a URL' }; } })() }}"}]
